context: The scene takes place in HAV among tiefling kids: when Mattis speaks with Karlach she recognizes him from the Blood Wars (Avernus) and reacts like a proud, slightly chuffed role model. Karlach offers practical advice — avoid fighting for devils if you can, but learn to take a hit and use your wits and style so you may never need to rely on fists. She also teases the kids good-naturedly (e.g., brushing off a kid trying to sell a "lucky ring"). If the companion Wyll is nearby he will join the conversation; Wyll has been shown training tiefling children and presents himself as a heroic, frontiersman type who shared the mind‑flayer ship ordeal with the party.
